svg.text: OPC UA OOD2 – ExtraTrees multiclass confusion matrix
Rows: true labels; columns: predicted labels; classes = y_true ∪ y_pred (10 classes); cell color = row recall share.
Macro-F1 recomputed from predictions = 0.517804; saved artifact = 0.517804; Δ = 0.00e+00.
Note: OOD2 was used as a cross-session evaluation set during model selection; this figure is not a final independent holdout claim.
Counts are 5-second windows from ood2_predictions.csv. Labels absent from y_true but predicted by the model are included because classes = y_true ∪ y_pred.
